subject: Term uplift orchestration, capacity cadence and QBR poll
messages:
From: Michael Grant <michael.grant@redwood.ai>
To: Emily Porter <emily.porter@averytech.com>
Cc: Monica Patel <monica.patel@redwood.ai>, Naomi Feldman <naomi.feldman@redwood.ai>
Date: Tue, 11 Jul 2028 09:02:00 -0700
Subject: Term uplift orchestration, capacity cadence and QBR poll

Hi Emily —

Following up on our renewal conversation last week. We’d like to get a short renewal sprint started to lock in the updated term, confirm the capacity uplift, and schedule the QBR/readout with your execs. High-level proposal attached; summary below: 

- Proposed term: 12 -> 24 months (annual billing, option to shorten at first renewal)
- Committed throughput increase: +2.5M tokens/month (target start: Oct 1)
- Recommended billing cadence: monthly with quarterly usage true-ups

Immediate asks for your team: 
1) Confirm the committed uplift number above or provide your updated forecast (attachment: AveryTech_internal_forecast.csv).
2) Share procurement/legal contact (we’ll kick off a redline loop once terms are selected).
3) Pick a QBR slot via this quick poll so we can lock an executive readout: https://forms.gle/qbr-poll-averytech-2028 (suggested window: week of Aug 14).

Attachments: 2028-07-11_AveryTech_renewal_proposal_v1.pdf (terms + pricing), AveryTech_capacity_runbook.xlsx (operational runbook draft).

Plan on our side: Monica will draft a mutual action plan (MAP) and Naomi will prepare a runbook for the uplift. If procurement is ready, we can start DocuSign once we align on the term.

If it helps, I’m available Fri 7/14 10–11am PT and Mon 7/17 1–3pm PT for a 30-min sync.

Thanks — look forward to your thoughts.

—
Michael Grant
Account Executive, Redwood Inference
michael.grant@redwood.ai | +1 (415) 555-0123

From: Emily Porter <emily.porter@averytech.com>
To: Michael Grant <michael.grant@redwood.ai>
Cc: Carlos Medina <c.medina@averytech.com>, Monica Patel <monica.patel@redwood.ai>, Naomi Feldman <naomi.feldman@redwood.ai>, procurement@averytech.com
Date: Tue, 11 Jul 2028 11:28:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Term uplift orchestration, capacity cadence and QBR poll

Hi Michael —

Thanks for the clear summary and the docs. Quick answers from our side: 
- Uplift: we can commit to +2.0M tokens/month initially (ramp to +2.5M by Dec) — I attached our internal forecast.
- Term: 24 months is acceptable; procurement will want a short clause for usage review at the 12-month mark.
- Procurement contact: procurement@averytech.com (cc’d).

QBR slots: the form shows a handful of options; our execs prefer the week of Aug 14 and are leaning toward Thurs 8/17 afternoon PT. If you can tentatively block that, we’ll confirm after procurement signs off.

Also: Carlos (cc) will coordinate internal SRE for the runbook details.

Best,
Emily
Emily Porter
Head of AI Products, AveryTech
emily.porter@averytech.com

Attachment: AveryTech_internal_forecast.csv

From: Monica Patel <monica.patel@redwood.ai>
To: Emily Porter <emily.porter@averytech.com>, Michael Grant <michael.grant@redwood.ai>
Cc: Naomi Feldman <naomi.feldman@redwood.ai>
Date: Wed, 12 Jul 2028 08:46:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Term uplift orchestration, capacity cadence and QBR poll

Thanks Emily — that uplift ramp looks workable and gives us a clear runway. Next steps from Redwood: 

1) I’ll draft a Mutual Action Plan (MAP) today that captures the term, uplift ramp, milestones for Oct 1 cutover, and legal/procurement checkpoints. I’ll share the draft in Drive and link it in this thread.

2) Naomi, can you confirm host prep and runbook owners? We’ll need an internal SRE contact from Avery (Carlos) to validate failover thresholds and cache warming steps in AveryTech_capacity_runbook.xlsx.

3) Michael — please tentatively hold Thurs 2028-08-17 2:00–3:00pm PT for the QBR executive slot; I’ll update the poll to mark that as the preferred time pending procurement.

Also noting procurement requested a usage-review clause at month 12 — we can accommodate language that triggers a joint review and adjustment process; I’ll add a short template to the MAP.

Monica Patel
Senior Solutions Engineer, Redwood Inference
monica.patel@redwood.ai | +1 (510) 555-0199

Attachment: (MAP draft link will follow in Drive)

From: Naomi Feldman <naomi.feldman@redwood.ai>
To: Michael Grant <michael.grant@redwood.ai>, Monica Patel <monica.patel@redwood.ai>, Emily Porter <emily.porter@averytech.com>
Date: Fri, 13 Jul 2028 15:18:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Term uplift orchestration, capacity cadence and QBR poll

Confirmed — I’ve provisionally scheduled the QBR for Thu Aug 17 2:00–3:00pm PT and invited the Redwood prep team. I’ll prepare the operational runbook readout (short slide deck + runbook checklist) and drop it in the Drive folder by Aug 3.

Quick ops notes for Carlos and Avery SRE: 
- We recommend warm-up traffic for 72 hours prior to Oct 1 cutover; we’ll provide a traffic generator and a checklist for KV-cache priming.
- There’s a small window for config freeze 48 hours before cutover to avoid drift during the ramp.

Emily — once procurement confirms, I’ll loop legal on the draft clause and we can start a tracked redline in DocuSign as Monica suggested.

Thanks — Naomi Feldman
Customer Success Manager, Redwood Inference
naomi.feldman@redwood.ai | +1 (646) 555-0147

Attachments: AveryTech_capacity_runbook.xlsx (updated checklist v1.1), 2028-07-13_runbook_notes.pdf
